versions.changelog:
- Added detailed SKILL.md describing the Element Plus Vue 3 desktop component library.
- Includes comprehensive trigger conditions for skill activation and usage scenarios.
- Provides a categorized quick index covering over 80 UI components, each with documentation links.
- Lists a full set of guide documents for design, installation, usage, theming, and more.
- Supports both Chinese and English descriptions for broad accessibility.

Initial release of element-plus-ui-vue3 skill.

- Provides comprehensive support for Element Plus UI components with Vue 3 and Composition API.
- Includes categorized quick index of over 80 desktop components: form, data display, navigation, feedback, and more.
- Offers links to detailed documentation and guides for setup, theming, i18n, SSR, and migration.
- Triggers automatically when Element Plus components or related UI features are required in Vue 3 desktop projects.
